correctness.rationale: A valuation-and-genus argument gives the complete 14-term regular differential basis; characteristic-five Cartier coefficient extraction is exact. Four fixed pivots reduce first rank to the explicit 2x2 block with determinant Delta. Frobenius-twisted products have proved sparsity; their minor 2(a e^5+1) and unique third-product term -b^31 imply all six cases, and the fourth product vanishes identically. The standalone symbolic verifier reconstructs these identities, followed by all 3125 F5 specializations. Finite tests are only corroborative.
